versions.changelog:
Initial release of folder-cleanup-assistant.

- Provides a professional tool for safe folder cleanup and organization with automatic backup before any operation.
- Uses move commands instead of delete commands to prevent accidental data loss.
- Supports both Mac/Linux and Windows environments (requires PowerShell on Windows); desktop usage only.
- Offers intelligent analysis of target folders and suggests tailored cleanup options based on file type, size, and age.
- Includes clear reporting and step-by-step confirmation to ensure transparency and recovery options for users.
